d:
Welcome to another episode of my journey to visit every country in the world.
This is a very special episode because Ecuador is my 195th country out of 197. That means I am now only TWO countries away from visiting every country in the world: Paraguay and Brazil.
In this video, I arrive in Ecuador and explore Quito, one of the highest capital cities in the world. I walk through the streets, meet locals, do some shopping, and experience the everyday life and atmosphere of this incredible country.
